rule: Founder 2026-11-08 ("find the surface of all these matches"): the surface of team-event matches (Davis Cup) that the feed and Tennis Explorer leave without one. Key = player key | date | te-join ourSurname(opponent). Value = [surface, indoor (1 indoor, 0 outdoor, null not stated), source index]. Wikipedia first (the tie box, indoor from its (i) mark or the season table), Tennis Abstract (TML) where Wikipedia has no tie; both agree on every match both name, except AUT v FIN and CYP v THA 2025, where press reports confirm Wikipedia (clay). Read by te-join.js on the career record only: fills a row with NO surface, never replaces one. Extended 2026-11-13 (founder: "find these surfaces out"): the remaining record rows with no surface or a carpet row with no court class — more Davis Cup ties, the 2025 World University Games (Essen, clay per FISU) and four ITF/Challenger events — same sources and order; a carpet row takes the table's court class (and its surface where Wikipedia names another).
